Container.Name: oob-manager
Container.Overview: Out-of-band management for Dell iDRAC 8/9 (other Redfish BMCs untested): health, sensors, event logs, firmware, power and fan control, serial and graphical console, with TOTP sign-in and an audit log. Read-only by default. First start: open the WebUI and enter the one-time setup code from the container log. Back up keys/age-identity in the data folder off this server. The data folder must be writable by the container user (99:100 below); if the log says "not writable", run: chown -R 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/oob-manager

Config.Name: WebUI (HTTPS)
Config.Description: HTTPS port of the web UI. Keep it on your LAN; do not forward it to the internet.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, generated keys and certificate. Back up keys/age-identity separately.

Config.Name: Go memory limit
Config.Description: Soft heap limit below the 256 MiB container limit.
